Messages.Body:
hi =)
a question about Twisting the Knife, for a change :

TwK is only usable if the minion succesfully inflicts 3 or more damage from
a hand or melee weapon.

That means
-if the damage is not dodged ?
or -if the damage is not prevented ?

hum... nothing prevents my herald of topheth to twist the knife of his
opponents, heh ?

reyda

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Reyda wrote:
> a question about Twisting the Knife, for a change :
>
> TwK is only usable if the minion succesfully inflicts 3 or more damage from
> a hand or melee weapon.
>
> That means
> -if the damage is not dodged ?
> or -if the damage is not prevented ?

Both.
Dodged strikes inflict no damage.
Prevented damage is inflicted but not successfully inflicted.

> hum... nothing prevents my herald of topheth to twist the knife of his
> opponents, heh ?

No.
